summary: AITX filed an 8-K furnishing a press release announcing that its wholly owned subsidiary Robotic Assistance Devices secured a third ROAMEO autonomous security patrol vehicle order from a longtime global logistics client. The unit will support security services for a leading cosmetics manufacturer, with deployment expected by calendar year-end. No financial terms, price per share, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation were disclosed. The order follows a second additional ROAMEO order roughly eight weeks earlier, indicating recurring customer adoption. This is an ordinary commercial/product order, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
